sloka: सद्भिराचरितं मार्गं गच्छ राक्षसुपुङ्गव ।माननीयो मम त्वं हि पालनीया तथा ऽस्मि ते ।। ७.२६.३९ ॥
transliteration: sadbhirācaritaṁ mārgaṁ gaccha rākṣasupuṅgava ।mānanīyo mama tvaṁ hi pālanīyā tathā 'smi te ।। 7.26.39 ॥

translations.english: O best of Rakshasas, follow the path practiced by the good; you are indeed worthy of respect to me, and I am similarly to be protected by you.
